upstream_api_review.spec_delta_from_previous_binding: Description-only over 0.9.0-rc.22: the client subset stays at 118 operations and the full specification at 387. With descriptions, summaries and info.version set aside both documents equal their RC22 versions, so no operation, parameter, request or response field, schema, status code, capability or limit changed; 50 client descriptions changed (51 in the full export, which also rewords info.description). POST /playback/sessions: a prepare that fails after its session is stored (the final recheck or the ticket, for example a refused private issuance) ends that session before returning the error, so it does not count toward the 32 active prepared sessions per user (#251). Nimbus private mode (#250): the version_id of a folder disc returns 409 disc_folder before any session is written or private ticket issued, and POST /playback/sessions/{id}/tickets for a session bound to a folder disc returns 409 disc_folder without a private ticket (both 409 descriptions name disc_folder; image discs and ordinary files are unchanged); features.prefetch_stream_limit_exempt and the stream and disc-file read descriptions keep a preload outside the concurrent-stream limit in private mode only when the composed private runtime declares it. The remaining descriptions replace internal database names (tables, columns, indexes, migration numbers) with public wording. In OPERATIONS.json only typed_sdk_schema_sha256.Media changes, because the Media.updated_at description was reworded; the typed SDK wire shapes are unchanged.
